resources.string: X3DH lets User 1 start an encrypted chat with User 2 while User 2 is offline. User 2 leaves a bundle of public keys on the server, and both sides end up with the same secret without ever sending it.

resources.string: Every new chat uses up a one-time prekey. When they run out, X3DH still works with three DH steps.
